name: ANDLINE Laravel Vue Node
author: ZinovevEzCode
description: Production runtime: Laravel + Vue/Webpack + /admin + Node.js WebSocket + Newt/Pangolin, Supervisor, Git deploy, MySQL/MariaDB + PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB drivers and isolated logs.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server/www /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/tmp
echo '[ANDLINE] Runtime directories created. App clone/update happens at runtime startup.'

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS Git repository for ANDLINE application.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Application branch to deploy.

variables.name: Git token
variables.description: Token for private Git repository.

variables.name: Auto pull
variables.description: Update from origin/GIT_BRANCH on every container start.

variables.name: Force build
variables.description: Force Composer/npm rebuild even when commit is unchanged.

variables.name: Run migrations
variables.description: Run php artisan migrate --force after new revision.

variables.name: Laravel optimize
variables.description: Run php artisan optimize after deploy.

variables.name: Admin directory
variables.description: Separate admin Vue application directory.

variables.name: Admin dist directory
variables.description: Built admin assets directory.

variables.name: WebSocket directory
variables.description: Node.js WebSocket application directory.

variables.name: WebSocket enabled
variables.description: Start Node.js WebSocket process.

variables.name: WebSocket port
variables.description: Internal localhost port for Node.js WebSocket.

variables.name: WebSocket public path
variables.description: Nginx path proxied to Node.js WebSocket.

variables.name: WebSocket start command
variables.description: Command executed inside WS_DIR.

variables.name: Queue worker
variables.description: Start Laravel queue:work.

variables.name: Scheduler
variables.description: Start Laravel schedule:work.

variables.name: Root build command
variables.description: Optional explicit root npm build command.

variables.name: Admin build command
variables.description: Optional explicit /admin npm build command.

variables.name: Newt enabled
variables.description: Start Newt userspace tunnel client for Pangolin.

variables.name: Pangolin endpoint
variables.description: Pangolin URL, for example https://pangolin.example.com.

variables.name: Newt ID
variables.description: Newt site ID issued by Pangolin.

variables.name: Newt secret
variables.description: Newt site secret issued by Pangolin.
